name: Bridging (Reformer)
summary: Roll the pelvis and spine up from the carriage with feet on the footbar, then press the carriage out and in.

layers.title: Pelvic curl
layers.text: Articulate up and down without moving the carriage.

layers.title: Bridge and press
layers.text: Hold the bridge and press the carriage out and in.

cautions.note: Long periods lying on the back later in pregnancy; keep sets short.
Keep to a low pelvic curl rather than a high bridge onto the neck.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
